pages.text: factor10 Menu X What we do Customers Articles Knowledge About Team Join Contact We know software We help companies solve business-critical challenges with software Ultimately, the goal is to find new or grow current revenue streams. Sometimes that means building something new, other times it involves improving what exists, or even figuring out what the real problem is in the first place. Our name comes from the simple belief that software – when done right – can amplify business impact by a factor of 10. Get real value from agentic coding, not just speed The gap between teams already getting real value from agentic coding and those who haven't started is growing fast. However, the fix isn't as simple as turning the agents on. Too often, what you gain in speed, you end up paying for later in tech debt, incidents, or code nobody wants to touch. To make sure your AI-assisted coding meets the same engineering standards as everything else you ship, you need guardrails in place that stop agents from cutting corners. We run presentations, workshops, and hands-on coaching on Agentic development. Whether it's getting your developers excited, bringing your teams up to speed, or finding the failure modes agents fall into and turning them into rules that hold across every session – we can help. How we can help with Agentic development → Improve your delivery performance under pressure For software organisations, when delivery keeps slipping despite the team working hard, the first instinct is often to add more people. But in our experience, the real problem isn't capacity, it's friction: slow pipelines, brittle architecture, unclear workflows. And adding more people won't solve that. What you need is a focused, time-limited intervention that makes your existing team faster, not bigger. We embed a small Anti-friction Team of experienced software architects alongside yours to find and remove what's slowing you down, one bottleneck at a time – without disrupting the ongoing delivery. Find out what our Anti-friction Team does → Multiply your sales capacity without multiplying your team For manufacturing companies with complex product systems, it’s easy to assume that someone must guide each customer through the options — one call, one quote, one email thread at a time. But complex products don’t have to mean complex sales. Our Self-service Solution Configurator concept puts that guidance into the tool itself, letting customers configure, validate, and quote their own solutions – instantly and accurately. The result: faster decisions, happier customers, and a scalable sales model. Explore what a Self-service Solution Configurator can do → Get clarity before making expensive decisions You're ready to scale up, but the software that once empowered you is holding you back. When roadmaps slip and no one can agree on why, it's tempting to rush into a rewrite, start reorganising teams, or bring in more people. And those can all be the right move – but not before you know what the real problem is. Our Architecture Review gives you that clarity, fast. We’re not looking to produce a thick report or a theoretical model. In two weeks, we'll investigate your system, workflows and delivery patterns, and come back with a clear diagnosis and concrete recommendations for next steps. See what our Architecture Review involves → They don't do what I say, but solve what I mean. I like that! Everything we do together is in the spirit of business value. Since they're so consistent in applying test-driven development, we always get quality. And they provide it with an unusual combination of speed and correctness. Who we help We work with three types of organisations. If you're one of them, we should talk. Manufacturing companies If you offer complex, configurable products and suspect there's more value to unlock from the way you sell and deliver them, we can help you use software to scale your commercial operations and get more out of every customer interaction. Software organisations If you have a capable team but delivery isn't where it needs to be, we can help you remove what's slowing you down – improving flow, quality, and overall effect without adding headcount or disturbing ongoing work. Scale-up companies If your software has served you well but is now holding you back — or you can see that it will — we can help you modernise your architecture so your system supports the next phase of growth instead of limiting it. pages.title: Self-service Solution Configurator | factor10
pages.text: Self-service Solution Configurator | factor10 Menu X What we do Customers Articles Knowledge About Team Join Contact Sell complex, configurable products at scale. Without more sales reps. A custom-built Self-service Solution Configurator lets your customers configure, price and quote their own solutions, putting them in control and freeing up your sales team to focus on closing deals. Start scaling your sales capacity! An end to sales bottlenecks If you’re a manufacturer or system provider with complex assortments, quoting a custom solution often means one call, one quote, one long email thread at a time. That manual process bottlenecks growth, burdens your sales team, and frustrates buyers. What if your customers could self-configure their solution, get accurate prices, and download CAD, BOMs and compliance docs exactly when they need to? What can a custom-built Solution Configurator do? Guide buyers step-by-step. Even complex systems with many variants get broken down into simple decisions. No Excel, no misinterpretations. A solution that solves their unique problem in their specific context. Generates accurate quotes – instantly. Prices, availability, lead time and documentation are calculated on the fly. Deliver the full package. CAD drawings. 3D models. STEP-files. BOMs. Certificates. Environmental & compliance data. All matched to the current configuration. Free up your sales & engineering teams. They no longer spend hours answering technical questions or generating manual quotes. Instead, they focus on strategic sales, customer relationships, and closing deals. One thing we’ve learnt from building Solution Configurators before: “what has been designed will be bought.” When engineers and customers use your tool, they become an extension of your sales team. Why it works – for you and your customers Friction-free buying experience. Your customers can explore ideas, configure options and compare variants on their own time, on any device. Aligns internal stakeholders. Being able to visualise and collaborate on a solution makes it easier for your customers to get all their internal stakeholders on board. And agree on a decision. Faster time-to-order. With instant quoting and documentation, cycles shorten. No more time-consuming back-and-forth between your sales team and the customer's engineering and purchasing. Insight-rich data. Every configuration, accepted or rejected, becomes data. You see which variants customers explore, which means early signals for demand, product development and inventory. Global & multilingual ready. Local prices, language and compliance are all automatically tailored. One tool, multiple markets, minimal overhead. Position your brand as modern, reliable and scalable. A robust, polished, always-available configurator reflects well on your brand and becomes a competitive moat. Stronger relationships. When you are easy to work with and help customers find the best solution to their problems, you become a valued part of their success. Trusted by companies like yours Roxtec International – global leader in cable and pipe sealing solutions "We estimate that half of our sales come from Transit Designer. In one way or another, this software is involved in almost all our product sales." – Mats Åhman, Head of Digital Solutions Seeing is believing: a well-designed tool super-powers your sales efforts! How Roxtec uses software as a driver of growth → Is a custom Solution Configurator the answer to your problems? We should talk if … You sell complex, configurable, variant-heavy systems. Each sale requires engineering validation, special documentation, BOMs or certifications. Your current quoting process is slow, manual, or inconsistent. You want to scale across geographies, languages, and customers without multiplying headcount. You know your clients and want to help them achieve more. What to do next Get in touch! We like to show you what’s possible, so we offer a free workshop to help you discover what value a custom-built Solution Configurator could bring. Either remote or in-person, we’ll think out loud together about your current blockers and come up with ideas to solve your sales challenges. Oh, and if you would like timely insights and tips about using custom software to simplify your sales funnel and grow your business, sign up for our newsletter! pages.text: About factor10 | factor10 Menu X What we do Customers Articles Knowledge About Team Join Contact We are factor10 An elite software consultancy factor10 is a software consultancy based in Sweden, founded in 2007. We are a small team of senior software architects and developers, specialising in Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Test-Driven Development (TDD), and software architecture modernisation. We work with industrial manufacturing companies, software product organisations, and scale-up companies across Sweden, Scandinavia, and internationally. What we do If we could only use two short phrases to describe what we do, it would be: solve bottlenecks and create leverage. Finding and solving the current bottleneck in our customer's business or software is our way of saying we always want to solve the most important problem at any given time. We love it when the outcome of a solution is disproportional to the work we put in – when the best and simplest solution to the right problem creates enough leverage to amplify the business impact by a factor of 10. In practice, it might look like a two-week architecture review that uncovers why a development team has struggled for two years. Or a custom-built solution configurator that lets a manufacturer's customers quote complex solutions themselves, freeing up time for the sales team. Or coaching a development team in Test-Driven Development so that faster delivery becomes the norm rather than the exception. Software is magic! It's a material consisting only of words, but which does things. To have it do something else, just use other words – it really is that easy. It's called software for a reason. Despite this, rigid legacy software is often the main obstacle for an enterprise to stay competitive, and the overall bottleneck to growth. Now imagine a situation where changes in software systems are easier, quicker and less costly than changing other aspects of your business. Imagine a rapid adaptation to new and unforeseen needs and opportunities. And imagine that the software actually is as soft as it is meant to be. That's not a utopian vision. It's what good software architecture and disciplined engineering practice actually look like. It's what we spend our days helping organisations build. How we work Everything we do is grounded in three principles. Not because we like methodology for its own sake, but because they help us consistently produce better outcomes for our clients. We call them our cornerstones , and they are: Theory of Constraints . A methodology for identifying the single bottleneck that limits value creation in a system. It's what keeps us focused on the most important problem for your business at any given time, rather than the most obvious or most convenient one. Domain-Driven Design (DDD) . An approach to software design grounded in a deep understanding of the business domain, developed in close collaboration with the people who know it best. It's how we make sure the software we build actually reflects how your business works – and stays aligned with it as things change. Extreme Programming (XP) . A disciplined approach to software delivery that keeps teams focused on working code, fast feedback, and continuous improvement. One of its most important practices is Test-Driven Development (TDD) that lets us move faster, collaborate better, and focus on maximising value without the constant fear of breaking something. XP helps us move quickly without accumulating the kind of technical debt that slows everything down later. The values that guide us Our values at factor10 are centered around four action verbs: Excel, Challenge, Care and Lead. More than just empty words in a document or on a webpage, these verbs guide how we act every day in society, toward our customers, together as a team, and as individuals. How we live our values every day → 10 Consultants We have chosen to stay as a small company. Growing faster could entail a risk of diluting the integrity of our offering. 0 Offices We have been a remote-first company since 2020. Our consultants work from locations across Sweden, with clients in Sweden, Scandinavia, and internationally. The world runs on software. That comes with responsibility. Together with our clients, we want to make the world radically better, using outstanding software as leverage. That means choosing to spend our time and knowledge on problems that matter beyond the next delivery. Right now, European values like privacy, transparency and democratic control are under threat in the digital space, and much of the infrastructure we depend on is controlled from outside Europe. We support EuroStack and other initiatives working to build a European digital infrastructure we can trust. In addition to moving our own systems and data to European cloud providers, we share our knowledge and experiences to help more organisations take that step. Quick facts about factor10 Founded: 2007 Consultants: 10 CEO: Per Rovegård Owned by: Prevas AB and Jimmy Nilsson Full company name: factor10 solutions AB Org.nr: 556720-5496 Check out our FAQ! Do you have more questions about how we work, who we work with, or what makes us different? Head over to our FAQ page! And if that doesn't answer your questions, feel free to get in contact and ask us in person! FAQ about factor10 → We are a Prevas company In early 2022 factor10 was partially acquired by Prevas. As a company, factor10 operates autonomously, in close collaboration with top management at Prevas. Being a part of Prevas' decentralized ecosystem in the Nordics, gives us more opportunities to help customers make more out of their business. pages.text: What we do | factor10 Menu X What we do Customers Articles Knowledge About Team Join Contact What we do We help companies solve business-critical challenges with software Sometimes that means building something new, other times it involves improving what exists, or even figuring out what the real problem is in the first place. Here are a few of the areas we often help our customers with. Faster delivery without sacrificing quality When teams are slow to deliver, the issue is usually a bottleneck in the system, not the people. We help you find what's holding things up – whether it's your architecture, your processes, or team dynamics – and get your delivery back on track. How we help companies improve delivery performance → Software architecture that keeps pace with your business Architecture decisions add up over time – bad ones can create problems for years. We review, challenge and improve your architecture, whether you need a quick second opinion or a thorough analysis of where your system needs to change. How we help companies make smart architecture choices → Get real value from agentic development Agentic coding changes how software gets written – not always for the better. We help you introduce it deliberately, with the practices in place to ensure you keep quality and ownership intact as AI takes on more of the work. How we help companies adopt agentic development → Multiply your sales capacity with a custom-built configurator Manual quoting is hard to scale. Our sales configurators let your customers configure, price and quote complex products themselves – freeing up your sales team, improving the customer experience, and shortening the path to order. How we help companies sell more with a configurator → Who we usually work with If you see your organisation or your challenges reflected here, we'd love to meet up and talk about how we could help you solve your business-critical problems with software. Manufacturing companies If you offer complex, configurable products and suspect there's more value to unlock from the way you sell and deliver them, we can help you use software to scale your commercial operations and get more out of every customer interaction. Software organisations If you have a capable team but delivery isn't where it needs to be, we can help you remove what's slowing you down – improving flow, quality, and overall effect without adding headcount or disturbing ongoing work. Scale-ups If your software has served you well but is now holding you back — or you can see that it will — we can help you modernise your architecture so your system supports the next phase of growth instead of limiting it. Three reasons to choose factor10 We start from the business, not the technology. Our goal is always to find the solution with the highest leverage; the change that generates the most revenue for our clients with the least effort. Typically, that means writing less code, not more. We work from a consistent set of principles. Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Extreme Programming (XP), Theory of Constraints (ToC), and Test-Driven Development (TDD) are not buzzwords we mention in pitches and ignore later. They have been at the core of how we work since factor10 started in 2007. All our clients receive the same proven approaches, rather than whatever the assigned consultants happen to prefer this year. We are small on purpose. factor10 has around ten consultants and no plans to grow into hundreds. Every client project includes truly experienced people. We don't have a setup where a senior consultant sells the work and a junior team does the actual work. Get to know us better → Want to know more? We would love to meet up and talk about how we could help you use software to increase revenue and amplify your business impact by a factor of 10. Please contact Jimmy today!
